description: The pie chart, titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)," illustrates the proportion of different token routing strategies used in a federated learning system for language models. The chart is composed of three distinct slices, each representing a different routing method. The largest slice, colored dark green, corresponds to the "LOCAL" routing strategy, which accounts for 94.5% of the total distribution. The second largest slice, colored maroon, represents the "LLM" strategy and makes up 3.9% of the distribution. The smallest slice, colored light blue, corresponds to the "EDGE_P2P" strategy and constitutes 1.6% of the total. The slices are arranged in a clockwise direction, starting with the "LOCAL" segment, followed by "LLM," and ending with "EDGE_P2P." Each slice is labeled with its corresponding category name and percentage value, and the chart includes a legend to identify the color associated with each routing method.
